title: The Prophet of the Carved Mountains
intro: In the harsh deserts of ancient Arabia, a figure emerged among people renowned for their extraordinary craftsmanship. Their homes rose from solid rock, yet their hearts were harder than the mountains they carved. A divine messenger arrived with a single, miraculous sign — but pride and defiance led to swift and terrifying consequences. Can you identify the noble servant whose people chose destruction over guidance?
clues: I was sent as a warner to my people, calling them to the worship of the One God.
My people lived among dramatic rock formations, carving magnificent dwellings into the mountainsides.
A miraculous she-camel emerged from solid rock at my prayer, a clear sign from the Almighty.
I told my people to share the water with this she-camel and not to harm it.
My people plotted against the she-camel and hamstrung her, sealing their own destruction.
A terrifying earthquake struck my people, and they were left fallen motionless in their dwellings.

trial.label: What was the defining trial?
options: The hamstringing of a miraculous she-camel
Building a great ark amid mockery
Being cast into a blazing fire
The breaking of the Sabbath covenant
trial.answer: The hamstringing of a miraculous she-camel

location.label: What was the central element?
options: A she-camel that emerged from rock
A staff that parted the sea
location.answer: A she-camel that emerged from rock

outcome.label: What was their ultimate fate?
options: A sudden earthquake from the heavens
Their cities overturned by divine command
outcome.answer: A sudden earthquake from the heavens

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
